sources.title: ussoewwin/ControlNet-models-ConvRot-INT8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🌟 Model Overview This repository hosts high-quality ConvRot INT8 quantized weights for all-in-one ControlNet Union and dedicated ControlNet models. By applying orthogonal Hadamard rotation prior to per-channel INT8 quantization, these models effectively eliminate activation outlier distortion and drastically reduce VRAM and disk footprint while preserving precise structural control fidelity:

sources.snippet: AI Model Storage Formats Before explaining INT8 ConvRot, I will explain the basics of AI model storage formats. Modeling and Quantization AI models are modeled in FP32, a 32-bit FLOAT type, for maximum precision in a general range, but since even SDXL results in a large file size of 12GB, they are converted to reduce the bit count to 16-bit, 8-bit, or in some cases 4-bit.
